qwen3.5:9b.note: Official Qwen3.5 9B. Starter default: same architecture as the previous default, from the vendor's own library tag. Ignores the /no_think soft switch; see docs/MODELS.md.

nomic-embed-text:latest.note: Current embedding model; matches the 768-dim sqlite-vec tables.

gemma4:12b-it-qat.note: Bake-off candidate for 12 GB cards (QAT build).

granite4.2:8b.note: Bake-off candidate; vendor positions it for extraction and JSON output.

embeddinggemma-2:270m.note: Embedding challenger: natively 768-dim, so the vector tables keep their shape. Dimension is vendor-reported; the installer's smoke test checks it.

gemma4:26b-a4b-it-qat.note: Bake-off candidate for 24 GB cards (mixture of experts, QAT build).

qwen3.5:4b.note: Smaller official Qwen3.5 for 8 GB cards. Expect lower quality than the 9B; run the bake-off before relying on it.

starter.description: What the tool needs to run: one chat model and the embedding model (about 7 GB download, fits a 12 GB card).

small-8gb.description: For 8 GB cards: the 4B chat model and the embedding model (about 3.6 GB download).

bakeoff-12gb.description: Starter plus the 12 GB candidates, to compare on your own data (about 21 GB).

bakeoff-24gb.description: The 12 GB bake-off plus the large candidates (about 72 GB).
